{{Top|leg}}
A '''Discharge energy cell''' was a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] that was placed in a [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]] in order to modify the energy output of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. This energy cell allowed skilled users to better deliver powerful attacks.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
